_note: Never add invented reviews. Until a Google Places API key is configured (GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY + placeId) the site shows a card linking to the Maps listing. rating/reviewCount stay null until real values are known.

text.en: See what patients say about their visits, straight from our Google listing. If we've looked after you, a short review helps other families find the right care.
text.te: మా గూగుల్ లిస్టింగ్‌లో రోగుల అభిప్రాయాలు చూడండి.
